name: Image Grid Tapes
description: Full-screen hero where a scattered grid of images drifts and rotates with the mouse, behind a large two-line title, with a smooth following ring cursor.
contents: Ten image tiles placed on a 50 by 50 grid
Large title with a smaller subtitle line
behavior: Tiles scale in and fade in from the center with a stagger
Tiles move and rotate toward the mouse position with eased lerp, each with its own random range
Ring cursor follows the mouse with easing and appears on first move, shown only on fine pointers
Native cursor is hidden over the component

props.name: fontFamily
props.default: Switzer, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

props.name: titleFontFamily
props.default: Zodiak, Georgia, Times New Roman, serif

editableByProps: Background, text, subtitle and cursor colors
Motion strength, easing, reveal timing and grid size
Cursor size, shape and visibility, fonts and title sizes
fixed: Hides the native cursor over the component
Loads the font stylesheet into document head when fontUrl is set
Mouse driven motion, on touch devices tiles stay static and the ring cursor is hidden
Root is full-width and one viewport tall
